chunks: It is narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Zayd, who said: I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:
Private relations become lawful through three means: marriage with inheritance, marriage without inheritance, and marriage through possession by the right hand.

key_terms.بِثَلَاثَةِ وُجُوهٍ: through three distinct ways or forms
key_terms.بِمِلْكِ الْيَمِينِ: through ownership by the right hand, a recognized legal category in the classical context
key_terms.نِكَاحٍ بِلَا مِيرَاثٍ: a marriage that does not include inheritance rights
key_terms.نِكَاحٍ بِمِيرَاثٍ: a marriage that includes inheritance rights

ai.seo_question: Through what means do marital relations become lawful according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith outlines three legally recognized means by which sexual relations become lawful in Islamic law. It distinguishes between forms of nikāḥ that do and do not entail inheritance, and also mentions ملك اليمين as a separate legal category.
